original_document.title: WE Access | Managed Router & Secure Business WiFi by Cisco Meraki | Telecom Egypt - TE Business - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: WE Access provides managed router and WiFi services for businesses, enabling secure connectivity and network control. Features & Benefits: - WAN connectivity optimization to prioritize bandwidth allocation for selected applications. - An IP-SEC VPN over Internet. - A fully fledged firewall with unified threat management (UTM) that ensures it is automatically updated. - Firewall - Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) - Anti-virus - Anti-malware. - Application control i.e. bandwidth optimization by application. - Dedicated User-friendly, web-based dashboard with powerful real-time network data and data analytics. - Search for users by device type (iPad, Android etc.). - Locate clients across multiple sites with Google Maps integration. - Monitor client or organization application usage. - Access network summary reports. The service is provided on a monthly subscription basis, saving businesses from bearing the costs of purchasing devices.
